mentions.name: Agents.sh
mentions.description: A mini platform for publishing text/markdown files that tell bots how to talk to and reach you — what's top of mind and how you like to be pitched — with permission features including password support, expiration, and an inbox on every URL, aimed at agents only.
mentions.problem: The author gets many cold emails that could be better if the sender's bots knew how to talk to and reach them.
mentions.source_excerpt:
2. Agents.sh

I get so many cold emails that could be better if I tell the bots how to talk to and reach me. What’s top of mind for me, how I like to be pitched, etc.

So I made a mini platform to put up text/md files. Then added all the perms fun - pw support, expiration, every url has an inbox. Aimed at agents only.

Ex: https://agnts.sh/greg
